established_this_checkpoint: derived independently: under an exactly matched universe, ordering by the coefficient equals ordering by intersection size for every common unseen count, since c1-c2 = (N+m)(w1-w2)/(d+m)^2
Jaccard induces the same ordering at k>0, checked on 4000 random configurations with no disagreement
empirically, ordinary Jaccard reproduces the coefficient's ordering in 270 of 270 pairwise comparisons in this lane's own retained counts
therefore the coefficient earns nothing over ordinary overlap for the ordering claim, and this lane should stop implying otherwise

withdrawn: the label free margin being wider does not establish stronger evidence, because the two views were never at matched marginals. Actual label free miss fractions are 0.238, 0.299 and 0.363 against the annotated 0.300, 0.400 and 0.500
the association caveat is moved into the result sentence: the caches hold only annotation matched detections, so this is an ablation conditional on that association

the recommended forward experiment is done: an annotation inaccessible constructor over the two original prediction submissions, opening those two files and nothing else, with the boundary asserted by a test over the module's own json literals

on raw two channel detections with the annotation inaccessible the sign of the dependence coefficient is NOT identified: m_star = x*y/w spans 11,771 to 162,021 across defensible score and radius choices, a ratio of 13.8
at score 0.2 and radius 1 m, positive coupling would require 162,021 unseen objects against 134,565 the public annotation records at all, which makes it implausible rather than merely unproven
the ordinary overlap baseline shares this exactly, since its intersection count is the same w, so this is a property of the two channel annotation free setting and not of one statistic
the five channel modality comparison is declared unresolved on raw inputs rather than approximated, because two submissions give no third observer
next_falsifier: Either a third already authorized original prediction submission, which would populate the empty both-missed cell and make the sign identifiable on raw inputs, or an externally justified association rule that does not come from annotations. Without one of those, no scalar over these two channels can support a sign, and this lane should not produce one.
